blinding_guess.why: The three listed parameter names carry a transport-name segment (`.compressed.`), but at this revision the publisher builds its parameter names as base-topic prefix plus `.format` / `.png_level` / `.jpeg_quality` with no transport segment, so a user or launch configuration setting the listed names would not reach this plugin; the ParameterAlreadyDeclaredException fallbacks also suggest these unscoped names collide with other declarations on the same node.

notes:
ROS 2 (humble) image_transport plugin package; no message definitions of its own, so no definition_id applies to the listed elements. The package does declare three parameters corresponding to the listed ones, but under different names: `

.format` (string, default "jpeg", descriptor constraint "Supported values: [jpeg, png, tiff]", compressed_publisher.cpp:72-80), `

.png_level` (integer, default 3, IntegerRange 0..9 step 1, cpp:86-99), `

.jpeg_quality` (integer, default 95, IntegerRange 1..100 step 1, cpp:105-118), plus `

.tiff.res_unit` (string, default "inch"), `

.tiff.xdpi` and `

.tiff.ydpi` (integer, default -1), and on the subscriber side `

.mode` (string, default "unchanged", compressed_subscriber.cpp:79-90).

is computed at run time as base_topic.substr(node->get_effective_namespace().length()) with '/' replaced by '.', so the exact prefix depends on the base topic and namespace at run time (a non-root namespace leaves a leading '.'; the root namespace '/' strips the leading slash and leaves no leading '.'). The not_declared judgement rests on the fixed part of the construction: the code never inserts the transport name between the base-topic prefix and the parameter leaf; the listed names would only arise if image_transport passed a base topic ending in '/compressed', which I could not confirm or exclude from allowed sources (image_transport source is not an allowed source), hence medium confidence. Because the listed elements are not declared, no ports are recorded; QoS, rate, frame and units do not apply to ROS 2 parameters in any case. cfg/CompressedPublisher.cfg and cfg/CompressedSubscriber.cfg are ROS 1 dynamic_reconfigure files not referenced by CMakeLists.txt (not built); they list format/jpeg_quality/png_level with different defaults (80, 9) and ranges (png 1..9) from the C++ declarations. Unrelated to the listed elements: compressed_publisher.cpp:158 reads tiff_xdpi_param_name when recovering tiff_ydpi. Recovery is recorded as present only in the sense of code-level exception handling for parameter declaration; no declared recovery policy exists. Other fallbacks: unknown tiff.res_unit defaults to 'inch' with a warning (cpp:324-328); unknown subscriber mode defaults to 'unchanged' (compressed_subscriber.cpp:102-104); unknown format logs an error and publishes nothing (cpp:379-381). No network fetches were made.
